title: Bucs score to start third quarter, trail Bears 17-13

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bucs score to start third quarter, trail Bears 17-13
sources.description: In his halftime interview with NBC, Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles said that he didn't go for a touchdown to close the second quarter largely because his team was going to receive the second-half kickoff with a chance to double up.
